description: Two independent pitch trackers, each reading the frequency of a signal by autocorrelation, naming the note and the cents error, and carrying the pitch out as a volt per octave

params.text: Shifts that channel's signal before it is measured and drawn, -5V to 5V
Shifts that channel's signal before it is measured and drawn, -5V to 5V
Sets how many cycles of the wave that channel's display holds, 1 to 6
Sets how many cycles of the wave that channel's display holds, 1 to 6
Scales that channel's signal before it is measured and drawn, silence to five times
Scales that channel's signal before it is measured and drawn, silence to five times

inputs.text: The signal whose pitch that channel measures
The signal whose pitch that channel measures

outputs.text: The measured pitch as a volt per octave against 261.63Hz, and 0V while no pitch is found
The measured pitch as a volt per octave against 261.63Hz, and 0V while no pitch is found

notes: the gain and offset controls change what is measured as well as what is drawn, so a large offset can stop the tracker finding a pitch at all
the pitch is taken from the first channel of a polyphonic cable only; the other channels are ignored
menu: Analysis speed: Precise, Balanced (default), Light, Minimal — trades how quickly the tracker settles on a new pitch against how much work it does
Large Hz display (disable waveform) — replaces the wave drawing with the frequency in large figures

outputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
